resources.string: Every invoice you check and save teaches the checker: the phone notes how each value was read and whether you kept it or corrected it. Numbers only: no supplier, amount or text of your documents. The checker can be trained from a few hundred invoices, in your own Google Colab; until it makes no mistakes on invoices it has not seen, nothing changes in the app.
